name: wiki-langgraph-research-v1
description: Initial evaluation cases for synthesizing curated project-session notes into grounded research briefs.

input.question: How should this application turn structured session notes into a meaningful Langfuse evaluation dataset for research quality?
source_notes: Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals

themes: Start with wiki.research synthesis rather than deterministic ingestion.
Use structured notes with decisions, evidence, gaps, and source session IDs.
Combine deterministic grounding and structure checks with model-based quality grading.
Keep evaluation separate from automated approval workflows.
gaps: The initial dataset size and score thresholds are not yet finalized.

input.question: What should a durable session-research note contain, and why is it better than storing raw transcripts?
source_notes: Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals

themes: Use metadata such as note type, project, status, tags, and source session IDs.
Organize content into summary, decisions, implementation or evidence, open questions, and follow-ups.
Curated notes improve retrieval, provenance, and evaluation explainability.
Secrets and raw environment values must not be copied into notes.
gaps: The project has not yet decided whether every manually authored note requires a source session ID.

input.question: How should LangGraph and Deep Agents be divided in this application, and what does that imply for evaluation?

themes: LangGraph owns deterministic ingest, compile, index, lint, and bounded control flow.
Deep Agents are opt-in for open-ended research or read-only review.
The agent loop is bounded by inspect, plan, act, verify, and replan iterations.
Evaluation should provide feedback without silently approving content.
gaps: It remains undecided whether research evaluation should run inside the bounded loop or as a separate experiment.

input.question: What operational safeguards are needed to run repeatable research experiments over this wiki corpus?

themes: Keep raw and compiled directories isolated in tests and deliberate in experiment runs.
Use deterministic low-cost settings while curating the corpus.
Track commits, test results, corpus version, and source session IDs.
Keep secrets out of notes and verify the configured endpoint and model before running.
gaps: A formal corpus-versioning and experiment-run naming convention still needs to be finalized.

input.question: What should the first Langfuse research experiment measure, and what should happen after the baseline run?
source_notes: Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals

themes: Run a small dataset through wiki.research using the existing trace hierarchy.
Measure grounding, expected-theme coverage, response structure, usefulness, and uncertainty handling.
Inspect failed examples in Langfuse before setting blocking thresholds.
Record dataset and evaluator identifiers for reproducibility.
gaps: The first five-to-ten questions and pass thresholds still require review.
